form.title: Add an entry
form.intro: A blocked address or domain can no longer deposit on this entity; a file whose SHA-256 digest is blocked is refused.

valueHint.email: A full email address, for example name@example.com.
valueHint.domain: A domain name without @, for example spam.example.net. Addresses of this domain are blocked.
valueHint.sha256: The 64 hexadecimal characters of the SHA-256 digest of the file.

form.commentHint: Why this entry was added, for the other administrators. Do not write personal data you do not need.
form.added: {value} has been added to the blocklist.

errors.sha256: Enter 64 hexadecimal characters (0 to 9, a to f).
errors.alreadyExists: This value is already in the blocklist for this kind.

delete.title: Remove this entry?
delete.text: {value} will no longer be blocked on this entity.
delete.done: {value} has been removed from the blocklist.
